title: The N-terminus of YY1 regulates DNA and RNA binding affinity for both the zinc-fingers and an unexpected nucleic acid binding domain
authors: Jimmy Elias; Jane J. Rosin; Amanda J. Keplinger; Alexander J. Ruthenburg
one_liner_zh: 该文通过体外核酸结合实验研究YY1转录因子的DNA/RNA结合域及N端无序区对结合亲和力的自抑制调控，虽以实验为主，但聚焦TF-DNA/RNA互作机制，对理解TF结合调控有参考价值。
abstract: Transcription factors (TFs) play central roles in dictating cellular identity and function by regulating gene expression programs. Beyond their well-folded DNA binding domains (DBDs) which recognize cognate DNA elements in the genome, TFs are enriched for intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs), which have a host of proposed functions including facilitating protein-protein interactions, aiding in binding site search, and binding RNA. Defining intrinsic regulatory properties of TFs requires further mechanistic investigation. We chose to investigate the DNA and RNA binding properties of Yin Yang 1 (YY1), a ubiquitously expressed TF directly involved in transcriptional activation, repression and genome architecture. Through systematic in vitro nucleic acid binding experiments we resolve conflicting literature defining the RNA binding interface of YY1, demonstrating that there are two RNA binding domains within YY1: its canonical 4 zinc finger DBD and a previously unannotated nucleic acid binding domain, which we term the REPO-NAB. Furthermore, we discover surprising autoinhibitory properties that the N-terminus of the protein imparts on each of these binding domains. Our results provide a new example of IDR-mediated regulation within TFs and enables future mechanistically precise functional investigations.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TFs）在决定细胞身份和功能中发挥核心作用，通过调控基因表达程序实现。除了其识别基因组中同源DNA元件的折叠良好的DNA结合域（DBDs）外，TFs富含 intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs)，这些区域具有多种提议的功能，包括促进蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用、辅助结合位点搜索以及结合RNA。定义TFs的内在调控特性需要进一步的机制研究。我们选择研究Yin Yang 1 (YY1)的DNA和RNA结合特性，这是一种普遍表达的TF，直接参与转录激活、抑制和基因组结构。通过系统的体外核酸结合实验，我们解决了文献中关于YY1 RNA结合界面的矛盾报道，证明YY1内存在两个RNA结合域：其经典的4锌指DBD和一个先前未注释的核酸结合域，我们将其命名为REPO-NAB。此外，我们发现了蛋白质N端对每个结合域施加的意外自抑制特性。我们的结果为TFs中IDR介导的调控提供了新例证，并为未来机制精确的功能研究奠定了基础。
